question.text: Under the Fourth Schedule (Code of Conduct for AIFs) read with Reg 20A of SEBI (AIF) Regulations, an AIF Manager's obligations include ALL of the following EXCEPT:

answer.text: Operate and manage the fund in the interest of ALL investors (not only Sponsor or select class)
Guarantee minimum returns to all investors for the fund tenure
Maintain written policies to identify and mitigate conflicts of interest
Have written AML/CFT policies aligned with applicable laws

explanation.text: The Logic: The Code of Conduct requires AIFs to invest per PPM objectives, operate in the interest of all investors, ensure dissemination of accurate and timely information, maintain risk management and internal controls, have written conflict-of-interest policies, avoid unethical marketing, and maintain AML policies. Guaranteeing returns is not part of the Code — hurdle or required returns are not guaranteed or assured returns. The Trap: Option B appears 'investor-friendly' but contradicts the no-assured-return framing for AIF units. Options A, C and D restate Code of Conduct obligations. Note: Workbook page 365 supports the Code of Conduct obligations in options A, C and D; pages 91, 118, 176 and 200-201 support the no guaranteed or assured return framing.
